name: unrelate

args.from: UUID of the node that the relation starts at
args.relation: name of the relation, for example HAS
args.to: UUID of the node that the relation goes to

description: The unrelate handler removes the relation from the first node to the second node. If the type constraints of the first node require the relation, nothing changes. The result tells if the graph changed. Use ungroup for MEMBER_OF.
